items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hank Jones was the piano player, Barry Gells was the guitarist, O.C. Johnson drums and yours truly bass.

ctx.x: Yeah. Who was in the New York Rhythm Section?

Hank Jones was the piano player, Barry Gells was the guitarist, O.C. Johnson drums and yours truly bass. And what it was about, we came to do the gig. Whatever you wanted we would do it. We could all read well, we could all play well, we could improvise, and we were disciplined enough to do whatever you wanted to do. This is the ability that most people didn‟t have at that time. They wanted to come on your record date and play the way they want to play and it‟s your date. So I had learned that from a long time…
